LOGIC ADVENTURE 24 · CLASS 30

Raccoon’s Secret Object

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Two-clue logic

Color plus shape — follow both clues and tap Raccoon’s secret object in every row.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · TWO-CLUE LOGIC

Raccoon’s Secret Object

Two clues name a secret object: a color AND a shape. Tap the object that matches both!

The secret object is BLUE and ROUND. Tap it!

The secret object is GREEN and BIG. Tap it!

The secret object is RED and ROUND. Tap it!

Every secret found!

A blue ball, a big green star, and a red circle.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Two clues at once (color AND shape) is real deductive logic. Say both clues aloud, test each object together, and let your child reject the near-misses.

Prefer paper? The Raccoon’s Secret Object worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
